_comment: Curated MCP servers shown under Connections → Add a connection. Only official or vendor-maintained servers (or archived MCP reference servers, marked as such). Each entry was checked against its source repository. One-click Add only prefills the form; nothing runs until the owner saves it.

entries.name: files
entries.title: Filesystem
entries.description: Read, write and search files inside one folder you choose on the gateway host.
entries.argsHint: Replace the last argument with the folder Sibyl may use. Add more folders as extra arguments.

entries.name: fetch
entries.title: Fetch
entries.description: Fetch a web page and convert it to markdown. Needs uv (uvx) on the gateway host.

entries.name: git
entries.title: Git
entries.description: Read and work with a local Git repository: status, diffs, log, commits. Needs uv (uvx).
entries.argsHint: Replace the last argument with the repository path.

entries.name: github
entries.title: GitHub (remote)
entries.description: Issues, pull requests, code and repositories through GitHub's hosted MCP server. Uses a personal access token; nothing runs on your host.

headers.label: Personal access token
headers.help: Create a fine-grained token at github.com/settings/tokens with only the repositories and scopes you want Sibyl to use.

entries.name: github-local
entries.title: GitHub (local, Docker)
entries.description: GitHub's MCP server run locally in Docker with your personal access token.

entries.name: postgres
entries.title: PostgreSQL
entries.description: Read-only SQL queries and schema inspection for a Postgres database.
entries.argsHint: Replace the last argument with your connection string. Use a read-only database user.
entries.note: Archived reference server: it works, but no longer receives updates.

entries.name: sqlite
entries.title: SQLite
entries.description: Query and analyse a local SQLite database file. Needs uv (uvx).
entries.argsHint: Replace the last argument with the path to your database file.
entries.note: Archived reference server: it works, but no longer receives updates.

entries.name: gdrive
entries.title: Google Drive
entries.description: Search and read files in Google Drive (read-only). Needs a one-time OAuth setup on the host.

env.label: Credentials file
env.help: Created by the server's one-time auth step; see the docs.

entries.note: Archived reference server. Requires a Google Cloud OAuth client and a one-time sign-in on the host.

entries.name: slack
entries.title: Slack
entries.description: Read channels and threads and post messages in your Slack workspace with a bot token.
entries.maintainer: Zencoder (continues the MCP reference Slack server)

entries.name: notion
entries.title: Notion
entries.description: Search, read and edit pages and databases your Notion integration can access.

env.label: Integration secret
env.help: Create an internal integration at notion.so/profile/integrations and share the pages it may use.

entries.note: Notion now favours its hosted MCP, which needs an OAuth sign-in Sibyl doesn't support yet; this local server uses an integration token.

entries.name: brave
entries.title: Brave Search
entries.description: Web, news, image and local search through the Brave Search API.
